<thought>Based on the exact mass (182.073 Da) the molecular formula is C13H10O. The 13C NMR shows a carbonyl carbon around 196 ppm and multiple aromatic carbons, consistent with a diphenyl ketone. The structure that matches these data is benzophenone, whose SMILES is O=C(c1ccccc1)c2ccccc2.</thought>
<final_answer>O=C(c1ccccc1)c2ccccc2</final_answer>
